text:
ashley: Quick spike notes on a minimal loader interface for safetensors sharded bundles. Thinking: manifest optional, loader should support index-first (manifest-driven) warmup or manifestless streaming. Warmup path chosen based on availability and policy.
raj: +1 for optional manifest. Main worry: atomicity when swapping shards. If relying on header offsets we need a safe handoff to avoid partial-read corruption.
sophia: What if we embed a compact "hotstart hint" in the file header with layer offset seeds + a small aggregate integrity checksum? Keeps manifest optional but gives deterministic warmup when present.
dash: Agree on tiny. Per-layer checksums blow up metadata. Single aggregate checksum + per-block seeds seems reasonable.
ashley: Proposed header.hint = {seed:..., map_crc:...}. Manifest still preferred for precise offsets; hint used only for progressive warmup to prime KV caches.
raj: Tradeoffs: index-first adds an extra object fetch (manifest) which hurts tiny-request throughput on Dedicated. Manifestless streaming can start sooner but risks readahead thrash.
sophia: Suggest policy: prefer manifest if object_size > 200MB or bundle tag "warmup_priority" is set. Otherwise stream-first. Make policy configurable per-deploy.
dash: API sketch: Loader.open(bundle_uri, {mode: "auto|index-first|stream"}) -> returns ReadHandle and WarmupPlan. WarmupPlan is a compact list of ranges to prefetch, e.g. 
```nWarmupPlan: ["layer0:0-2MB","layer1:0-256KB"]
```
ashley: Also require fallback: if index-first manifest fetch fails (404/timeout) switch to streaming and surface a warning, don't fail entire load.
raj: Atomic swap: require ingesters to finalize bundles (content-addressed name or .final marker). Loader should reject header hints until a final marker/lease is present. This shifts complexity to ingestion but simplifies runtime correctness.
sophia: For air-gapped/private deployments where object-store rename/finalize isn't available, add a lease handshake: loader checks a .lock/.final marker or an explicit HTTP header before trusting offsets.
dash: Perf spike numbers: manifest fetch ~12ms on s3-like store. Streaming per-chunk start ~1.2ms but readahead multiplies cost. For models with many layers (8+), manifest-first shows lower total warmup latency. For very small bundles (<100MB), stream-first often wins.
ashley: Telemetry: emit warmup.path=(manifest|stream), warmup.latency_ms, warmup.fallback=(none|index-miss). Expose these to Optimize to tune policy.
raj: Backcompat: most existing safetensors won't have hints. Default to stream-first for those and provide a migration CLI that annotates bundles with tiny hints and finalizes them.
sophia: Migration CLI idea: `rwdx annotate-hint bundle.safetensors --finalize` which computes per-block seeds and an aggregate CRC and writes a sidecar or header patch.
dash: infra-bot: ran unit spike tests on s3-emulator. 24/24 warmup permutations exercised. Branch: spike/loader-hints. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234
ashley: Next steps: draft a short RFC with loader API, hint schema (compact), lease/finalize requirements, and ingestion CLI. Will ping on Friday for review.
raj: I'll add microbench for small bundles to justify threshold tuning.
sophia: I'll mock the telemetry in Optimize to estimate cost impact once events are available.
ashley: Closing spike notes here. :thumbsup:
